intended_use: Screening-level chronic condition risk estimation; NOT a standalone diagnostic device.
estimand_clarification: All outputs predict cross-sectional prevalent condition status or survey-reported lifetime doctor-diagnosed history in civilian adults; they do NOT predict 10-year prospective future incidence.

diabetes.estimand_description: Cross-sectional probability of current undiagnosed or diagnosed Type 2 diabetes based on phenotypic and lipid markers with fasting glucose and HbA1c strictly withheld.

hypertension.estimand_description: Probability of existing or doctor-diagnosed high blood pressure based on resting blood pressure measurements, body measures, and demographics.

high_cholesterol.estimand_description: Probability of doctor-diagnosed elevated blood cholesterol or active dyslipidemia based on measured lipid panel and patient history.

heart_disease.estimand_description: Probability of prior doctor-diagnosed coronary heart disease, angina, or myocardial infarction; NOT a future incident event forecaster.

stroke.estimand_description: Probability of prior doctor-diagnosed stroke or cerebrovascular accident history.

copd.estimand_description: Probability of doctor-diagnosed emphysema or chronic bronchitis history.

leakage_safeguards: Self-defining diagnostic questionnaires strictly excluded. Glycemic diagnostic tests (HbA1c/Glucose) excluded from diabetes prediction.
disclaimer: These models estimate cross-sectional prevalence and survey-reported clinical history. They do not predict prospective 10-year future incidence and cannot replace medical diagnosis.
